name: designforge-monorepo
description: DesignForge - AI-Powered LLD Practice Studio (Design. Defend. Improve.)

scripts.bundle:api: esbuild scripts/serverless-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:@prisma/client --outfile=api/index.js
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@designforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@designforge/api && npm run build --workspace=@designforge/web && npm run bundle:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@designforge/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@designforge/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@designforge/web
